coverage_policy: Only predictions whose frame lies inside an inclusive fully reviewed interval may be TP or FP. A GT event is evaluable only when its full native-timestamp uncertainty interval plus the 0.200 second matching margin is inside reviewed coverage, truncated only by a physical video boundary. Eligible predictions adjacent to a boundary-censored GT are excluded symmetrically. All other predictions are OUTSIDE_SCOPE.
